title: For så høyt har Gud elsket verden

request.style: English, Norwegian revival song, a young male voice with a guitar and accordion duo, a lively prayer house sing-along with clapping on the refrain, 4/4, 104 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was a sinner far from God
And did not know the way
But then I heard the word of life
That speaks to you today

[Chorus]
For God so loved the world
That he gave his only Son
So that everyone who believes in him
Should not perish but have eternal life

[Verse]
Now I will sing it out to all
Who are weary, who are small
It is not for the good alone
It is grace from God for all

[Chorus]
For God so loved the world
That he gave his only Son
So that everyone who believes in him
Should not perish but have eternal life
